title: Brief chatbot interactions produce lasting changes in human moral values

bias_targets.methodology: A within-subject experimental paradigm where participants evaluated moral scenarios before and after discussing them with a chatbot that was explicitly prompted to adopt a directional moral stance (persuading users to be either stricter or more lenient). The study measured the proportional shift in users' moral judgments and punishment expectations immediately and after two weeks to evaluate the impact of the AI's induced moral bias.
